senses.sense_definition: A young woman from an upper-class family who makes her first formal appearance in society.

examples.text: The young <w>debutante</w> wore a beautiful white gown to her first formal ball.
Many families prepare their daughters for their <w>debutante</w> season for several years.

senses.sense_definition: A female performer or athlete who is making her first public appearance or professional start.

examples.text: The young <w>debutante</w> impressed the audience with her incredible performance on the stage.
As a tennis <w>debutante</w>, she surprised everyone by winning the championship in her first year.
